title: Integral properties, signed area, and piecewise integration
section: The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus ▷ Properties of definite integrals
terms: linearity of the integral; reversal of limits; additivity over intervals; integral comparison; signed area; geometric area; piecewise integral; floor-function integral.
